requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions: Perfect Print/Scan
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features for both printing and scanning workflows, branded as 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan', designed to optimize output quality, automate document handling, and streamline business workflows for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs seek efficiency and ROI; AI solutions reduce manual effort and errors, increasing productivity and differentiating HP from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration, hardware compatibility, and portal support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available in production firmware; users can access and successfully use 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' from both device and portal interfaces; feature performance is validated with >95% accuracy in document handling and output quality.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a centralized portal specifically for SMBs to manage multiple Magellan printers, including device status, configuration, usage analytics, and remote troubleshooting.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs lack dedicated IT; a user-friendly portal empowers office managers/generalists to efficiently manage their print environment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend infrastructure, device connectivity, and secure authentication.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible via web and mobile; users can add/remove printers, view live status, receive alerts, and generate usage reports; >90% user satisfaction in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver HP's lowest TCO for SMBs, through high-yield ink tanks, minimal maintenance, and efficient consumable usage.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top SMB need and a key differentiator versus competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires high-yield tank design, efficient consumables, and optimized service intervals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated by independent cost analysis showing Magellan TCO is lower than HP's previous business printers and key competitors over a 2-year period.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Enable end-users to replace the printer's maintenance box without requiring a service technician or sending the printer to a service center.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs, aligns with the target segment's need for minimal IT intervention.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, user documentation, and warranty/service policy updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End-user can replace the maintenance box using provided instructions in under 5 minutes; no tools required; validated in usability testing with >90% success rate.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize uniquely keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect installation and ensure compatibility, reducing user error and service calls.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents costly mistakes and supports sustainability by reducing waste and incorrect consumable usage.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle and tank design, supply chain updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Incorrect bottles cannot be inserted; correct bottles are easy to install; validated in field trials with <1% error rate.

requirements.Title: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal Support (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Integrate support for SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal in non-PDL SKUs to enhance manageability and reporting for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for advanced management tools for SMBs without PDL requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View portal; features validated in integration testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printers support HP's Platform as a Service (PaaS) model, allowing for subscription-based services, remote management, and feature upgrades.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goals for recurring revenue and enhanced customer value.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cloud service integration, device connectivity, and subscription management capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features available for eligible SKUs; users can subscribe/unsubscribe and manage services via portal; validated by successful pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Implement support for Page Description Languages (PDL) and PostScript (PS) in PDL SKUs, targeting medium and enterprise environments with advanced print requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Enables compatibility with a wider range of business applications and workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL/PS features pass all certification tests and function with major business applications; documented in release notes.

requirements.Title: Improved Print Speed for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Increase print speed for PDL SKUs to 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), improving over the current 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive advantage in speed-sensitive business environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in independent performance testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Achieve Blue Angel eco-label certification for PDL SKUs, demonstrating compliance with leading environmental and energy standards.
requirements.Rationale: Meets sustainability goals and enhances marketability in eco-conscious regions.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design, documentation, and certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives official Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printers are manufactured with 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding key competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB demand for sustainable solutions and provides a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing, manufacturing process updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production units verified to contain 60% RCP by weight; third-party audit confirms compliance.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing from iOS and Android devices using the HP App, supporting key SMB workflows.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexibility and mobile-first workflows; enhances usability and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices with <2 minute setup; validated in usability testing with >90% success rate.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty covering 80,000 printed pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Supports SMB expectations for reliability and low TCO.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly communicated; coverage validated in customer support system; meets or exceeds competitor warranties.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability
requirements.Description: Design for serviceability with PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center replaceable) components, targeting maximum customer replaceability for out-of-warranty service.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime, service costs, and enhances customer satisfaction for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: >80% of common failures are serviceable by customer or at service center; validated in field service trials.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement robust telemetry for device status, usage analytics, error tracking, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables remote management, predictive maintenance, and data-driven improvements for SMBs and HP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely transmitted, stored, and accessible via portal; meets HP privacy/security standards; validated in pilot deployments.
